ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Adani Power Limited (APL) has secured final National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) approvals for the amalgamation of ten wholly-owned subsidiaries, including Vidarbha Industries Power Limited (VIPL), into APL, with an appointed date of April 1, 2025. This internal restructuring aims to simplify the corporate structure, enhance operational scale, and improve financial strength, with no new shares to be issued by APL. While a previous "Emphasis of Matter" in VIPL's audit due to prior insolvency and negative net worth was flagged, it was deemed resolved as APL acquired VIPL via the IBC process and the negative net worth is not expected to materially impact the positively capitalized combined entity.
